## Summary

Describe what this PR changes and why it is needed. Keep it short and clear.

Closes: #<issue-id> (if applicable)
ADR: docs/decisions/ADR-XXX-<title>.md (if this PR changes a decision)

## Screenshots or clips

Include a screenshot or short clip if the UI changed.

## Type of change

- [ ] feat - new feature
- [ ] fix - bug fix
- [ ] chore - tooling or maintenance
- [ ] docs - documentation
- [ ] refactor - code change that does not add features
- [ ] test - adds or updates tests
- [ ] ci - build or pipeline changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Small, focused scope
- [ ] Code builds locally
- [ ] Lints clean
- [ ] Tests added or updated and pass locally
- [ ] i18n - all user facing strings use translation helpers
- [ ] i18n - English and German copy added where required
- [ ] Accessibility - keyboard support and labels for new controls
- [ ] Screenshots or clips added if UI changed
- [ ] No console logs or stray TODOs
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or API changed
- [ ] Security and privacy reviewed - no secrets, no PII in logs
- [ ] Performance considered - avoid blocking work and heavy deps
- [ ] Feature flagged or safe defaults if risk of regression

## Risk

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High

If Medium or High, include a short rollback plan.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything that will help reviewers understand scope, decisions, or trade offs.
